description: Our kitchenware is truly a family enterprise-- Inspired by our heritage and sparked into existence by our international family adventures. Cooking with ceramic non-stick pans on a family trip to Italy sparked our inspiration. Coming from generations of restaurateurs, we immediately recognized the potential for transforming our at-home cooking experience. After months of developing our Vesuvio pan for American kitchens, we are proud to bring this revolutionary product into YOUR kitchen.
